units.rawText: Welcome, Professor. I've received the notification from Persicaria... I would've never thought you had lost your memory too, Professor.

units.rawText: Professor, you know I also don't have my memories of the past. Even now, I don't remember anything of when I was in the real world. My starting point is still at the time when you awakened me in Cyclopes.
